questions.question: When many northern kings camped with a huge army to fight Israel, what did the LORD tell Joshua?

answers.text: Do not be afraid of them
Do not go out against them

questions.question: The LORD told Joshua to hamstring the horses of the northern kings. What was Joshua to do with their chariots?
After defeating the northern kings' armies, why did Joshua turn back to capture the city of Hazor?

answers.text: It had been the head of all those kingdoms
It had the strongest walls in the whole north
It sat the closest to the camp of Israel
